title: Neon Pulse Courier
archiveRole: First Arcade Reaction Hall observation sample
description: A PC-first arcade reaction benchmark about steering a courier signal ship through rhythmic pulse barriers, collecting data parcels, preserving combo, and surviving until extraction.

deviceSupport.mobileNotes: PC-first benchmark tuned for keyboard, mouse, and 16:9 desktop play. Mobile baseline supports loading, no horizontal overflow, tap/drag movement, and action buttons in local browser viewports, but precise reaction play is intended for desktop. No physical handset QA is claimed.

provenance.notes: Initial canonical implementation for Observation 003 / Game 003. Code, metadata, screenshots, and documentation were generated by Codex under the no-human-code-edits project rule.
